description: An international goods exporter uses ships and planes to transport goods. A ship can take 40 containers worth of goods and uses 500 liters of fuel per trip. A plane can take 20 containers worth of goods and uses 300 liters of fuel per trip. The company needs to transport at least 500 containers worth of goods. In addition, there can be at most 10 plane trips made and a minimum of 50% of the trips made must be by ship. How many of each trip should be made to minimize the total amount of fuel consumed?

ShipCapacity.definition: Capacity of a ship in containers

ShipFuel.definition: Fuel usage of a ship per trip in liters

PlaneCapacity.definition: Capacity of a plane in containers

PlaneFuel.definition: Fuel usage of a plane per trip in liters

MinContainers.definition: Minimum number of containers to transport

MinShipTripFraction.definition: Minimum fraction of trips that must be by ship

objective.description: "Minimize the total amount of fuel consumed by ship and plane trips"

constraints.description: ShipTrips and PlaneTrips must be integers
